crcPolicySources.defaults: The pinned driver supplies only its bound ordinary flags; snapshot defaults enable validated glossary reuse and disable skip-fused parsing
crcPolicySources.metricScope: Only deferred verification writes scanned/reused counters; immediate inflation validates original CRCs but worker metrics report0
crcPolicySources.nativeVerifier: The unchanged source-bound native parser exports verify_term_bank_source_crcs; complete original native rebuild and parser asset identities are separately required
crcPolicySources.versionAndValidation: The pinned importer admits the recorded compressed-worker route only for version3 and sets validateGlossaryTypes=true; request receipts do not independently record those options

limitations: Real nonpersistent memory SQLite plus disk OPFS-shaped sidecars
Only complete term-content/record/index and field bytes are compared
No browser persistence, restart, image decoding, complete-media or performance qualification
Successful raw sinks were independently rehashed then retired by the original producer; this reader compares retained complete-byte receipts

adapter writer exclusion and locked directory deletion
